name: System Monitor
description: Read-only host reachability and Node Exporter resource metrics for homelab systems.

capabilities.name: config.get
capabilities.reason: Read administrator-defined host inventory and metric collection settings.

capabilities.name: http.request
capabilities.reason: Fetch bounded Node Exporter metrics from configured hosts through NAD core.

capabilities.name: notifications.emit
capabilities.reason: Send administrator-requested test events through NAD core-owned notification channels.

permissions.label: View system metrics
permissions.description: View host status, uptime, CPU, memory, and disk usage.

permissions.label: Send test notification
permissions.description: Send an explicit System Monitor test event through NAD core notification channels.

configSchema.label: Hosts
configSchema.description: Comma-separated name|host entries. Names must be unique.

configSchema.label: Check method
configSchema.description: Node Exporter provides resource metrics. HTTP reachability reports online/offline only.

configSchema.label: Node Exporter port
configSchema.description: Shared Node Exporter port for configured hosts.
